_note: Test shop round 2 (2026-11-13). Read on every shop request - edit and reopen the shop, no restart needed. Change 'updated' (to a later time) when the items change so the game re-downloads the category. Lineup entry = [type 1 single/2 bundle, product id, name, field3 (unknown, 0), CURRENCY, purchase limit (0 = none), field6, field7, field8, text9, text10, text11, field12, [[product id, item type, item id, PRICE]]]. CURRENCY codes (from the game's after-purchase code, sub_140A189E0): 1 = TP tokens, 2 = Zeni (status part 1 [2]), 3 = Possible_ TP medals (status part 1 [4]). PRICE = the last number of the item entry (ShopItem +0x18, shown on the tile). Item types: CostumeItemID, RivalID, StampID, EmotionID, ... (see SHOP_FORMAT_NOTES.md). Buying (shop/payment) takes the price from the player's saved status and adds the Raider (Assets/rival-templates.json) or costume.
